spans.s: --a hell: chiefly dealers in sheep, and cattle, Cakradhvaji, ब्राह्मण gambler, begger in the village, prisoner, washermen, sellers of soma, drinker of wine, meat eaters, killer of cattle, dealer in buffaloes, un- grateful friends, one who eats from bastard (कुण्डु) oil- monger, hunter of animals, iron seller and tale bearer go to this hell. See रुधिराम्भ. Br.

--(see रुधिरान्ध) a hell into which are thrown ब्राह्मण actors, fishermen, prisoners, informers, those living by their wives' immoral earnings, those attend- ing to secular affairs on Parvas, incendiaries, ungrateful companions, sooth-sayers, magic performers and sellers of the juice of trees. Vi.
